start: 'Track RPE' on; Bench Press set 1 has 60 kg and 8 reps typed, not ticked

user_sees: Rows 10 down to 6, each with words such as '2 more reps left' for 8
must_not: The set type choices mixed into the sheet
The set ticked before a value is picked

user_sees: The sheet slides away, then the set's tick turns green with a short pop
The RPE cell shows 8 in its colour
must_not: The tick done while the sheet still covers it
A second tap on the tick needed to start the rest

tests.checks: the delay is 350 ms (120 with reduce motion), only a still-unticked set is ticked, the card source re-reads the set then ticks, pops and starts the rest; no screen is driven

start: 'Track RPE' on; set 2 is already ticked

steps.action: Tap its RPE cell and tap '9'
user_sees: The sheet closes; the cell shows 9 ('1 more rep left')

steps.action: Open the cell again and tap 'Clear RPE'
user_sees: The cell is empty again; the set stays ticked
must_not: 'Clear RPE' shown on a set with no RPE

start: 'Track RPE' on; a new exercise, set 1 has no weight and no grey hint

steps.action: Tap the RPE cell and tap '8'
user_sees: The sheet closes; the RPE is kept
The row says what is missing and puts the cursor in the weight box
must_not: The set ticked with an empty weight
The sheet closing with nothing said

start: 'Track RPE' on; set 3 has numbers typed, not ticked

steps.action: Tap the RPE cell, tap '7', and tick the set by hand at once
user_sees: The set ticked once and stays ticked
must_not: The set unticked by the late automatic tick

steps.action: Minimise the workout and open it again
user_sees: The tick shown without its pop again
must_not: The pop played again on a set ticked long ago

tests.checks: shouldAutoTick refuses a set already done; shouldPlayTickPop refuses a pop older than 1.5 s
